scope: Cross-domain historical authority and proof-boundary composition

findings.native_result: Every verified cross-domain edge has a machine-readable compatibility contract; reconstruction manifests bind exact producer authority and typed results in a proof-boundary fingerprint.
findings.legacy_boundary: Rows without material producer pins remain insufficient or permanently unavailable and cannot use heuristic/current substitution.

cross_domain_proof_information: Legacy provider/revision authority absent from immutable evidence remains permanently unavailable.
Purged pre-certification source bundles cannot be recreated by composition.
A missing historical configuration/rule/deployment authority cannot be inferred from current state or co-location.
External provider archives, privileged SQL and retention governance remain outside repository-enforced proof boundaries.
Winner birth PriceBar revision availability remains WIN-006; T16C does not relabel it.

hard_boundaries: No current producer may replace missing historical authority.
No same-run, same-ticker, timestamp-nearest or same-value inference.
No false CERI, Setup, Lifecycle, direct IBMI or reverse Sector-to-Ranking dependency.
No claim about external governance enforcement.
